core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haram corresponds to the Arabic form حرم (Arabic root ح ر م (ḥ-r-m); حَرَم (Ḥaram)). Its core sense is forbidden, inviolable; sacred precinct. Haram is Arabic حَرَم (Ḥaram) 'a sacred precinct, an inviolable place; also حَرَام (ḥarām) 'forbidden'', from the root ح ر م (ḥ-r-m). The source gloss 'forbidden, sacred' conflates two related but distinct words; both senses are recorded here. The word appears in the Qur'an. Used for both men and women.
